name: html-book-kit
description: Marketplace for the Claude HTML Book Kit plugin (book-kit).

plugins.name: book-kit
plugins.description: Turns lesson sources (PDF/PPTX/DOCX/Markdown) into an accurate, easy-to-picture HTML summary book: configurable summary levels (exam review / study) kept side by side, a 5-agent pipeline gated by deterministic scripts (zero-token build, SHA-256 freshness checks from source to page, coverage derived from the plan), AA-checked colour palettes, and a report -> ask -> stop audit gate.
